Irene (sales): Quick request 8: new POC for Nimbus. They want hosted API keys + a tiny Dedicated pool for evaluation, VPC peering, and a billing project with a $3k spend cap + $1.5k starter credits. Can we do this fast?
Hector (billing): We can. Need org_id, billing email, and whether they want a hard-stop at the cap. Also confirm allowed models and daily token quota.
Irene (sales): Org is nimbus-inc-202, billing@nimbus.inc. They asked for hard stop. Allowed models: 13B quantized only. Quota: 300k tokens/day, 220 rpm. Regions: us-west-2 primary.
SaaS Eng (solutions): For tiny Dedicated pool, 1x A10G-equivalent should cover burst to 25-30 rps. We'll pin model family to prevent accidental 70B usage. Set routing: dedicated preferred, hosted fallback to very-small models only.
Mika (infra): For peering we need their VPC CIDR, desired peer subnet, and list of egress IPs to whitelist. If they want private DNS, note that. Peering ETA ~2 business days after we have those.
Compliance Bot: Reminder: hard-stop requires signed POC addendum. If they want CMEK, we need KMS ARN and a security review (5+ days). Logs retention can be set per-project.
Hector (billing): Minimal provisioning payload I need:
```
org_id: nimbus-inc-202
billing_email: billing@nimbus.inc
spend_cap_usd: 3000
starter_credits_usd: 1500
allowed_models: "13b-quantized"
quota_tokens_per_day: 300000
quota_rpm: 220
regions: "us-west-2"
hard_stop: true
vpc_cidr: <customer_vpc_cidr>
logs_retention_days: 30
kms_arn: <optional_kms_arn>
```
Hector (billing): Send that plus signed addendum and I'll create the billing project and enable hard-stop. Hosted API keys can be created same day.
Irene (sales): I'll collect CIDR + signed addendum today and post here.
DevEx Bot: Quick tip: use scoped ephemeral keys for engineers. CLI example for temp project: `redwoodctl project create --org nimbus-inc-202 --name=nimbus-poc-temp --spend-cap=3000 --credits=1500 --models=13b-q --quota-tokens=300000 --quota-rpm=220 --regions=us-west-2` then `redwoodctl keys issue --project <id> --type ephemeral --ttl 7d`.
SaaS Eng (solutions): After billing creates the project, I'll request the Dedicated pool and attach routing rules. Expect pool ready ~48 hours after infra peering is configured.
Mika (infra): I'll pre-approve the subnet ranges to speed up peering. Once addendum & CIDR are in, I'll open the peering ticket.
Irene (sales): Thanks all  I'll update once I have documents. :thumbsup:
